description: Use this skill when the user asks to research a market, industry, or competitive landscape. Also triggers on 行业调研, 竞品分析, 市场分析, 桌面调研, research this market, 调研一下, 帮我调研, 查一下XX市场. It enforces a structured credibility-scored research protocol (source tiering, cross-validation, graded conclusions) instead of ad-hoc web searching.
